infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SoapNotesAi records your dictation to generate SOAP notes. Audio is sent only to the services you have configured.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SoapNotesAi uses the camera to scan paper records, such as old notes and reports, into a patient's file.

plugins.microphonePermission: SoapNotesAi records your dictation to generate SOAP notes.

plugins.cameraPermission: SoapNotesAi uses the camera to scan paper records, such as old notes and reports, into a patient's file.
plugins.photosPermission: SoapNotesAi saves scanned records to the patient's file; it does not browse your photo library.
